method: Authored challenge cases frozen before compiler integration; once used for implementation, these are development cases, not an independent held-out accuracy estimate.

cases.rationale: Imported interface alias resolves a single boolean-returning call.
Compiler chooses the address overload returning bool; bytes32 overload returns nothing.
Later write refers to inherited storage, with a reachable deposit path.
Inherited storage is updated before the external call.
Imported void method has no boolean to check.
Compiler resolves both imported struct members as dynamic hash inputs.
Repeated unscaled value credit writes inherited storage.
A local shadow of inherited storage is not a state write.
